paragraphs: AMP designs, builds, and operates facilities that sort single-stream recycling and municipal solid waste using artificial intelligence. The buyers are waste companies and municipalities, offered sortation services and automation at scale.

The facility product, AMP ONE, is a fully automated sorting plant. It takes in single stream material, municipal solid waste, plant residue and mixed plastics and turns them into bales. Dozens of jet sorters and cameras characterize the stream continuously as it passes. Each finished bale is tagged with a bar code linked to the composition and purity of the material inside it.

For municipal solid waste, AMP states that it operates the facility itself and charges a per-ton processing rate with guaranteed diversion. The company puts typical diversion above 60 percent. It says custom plants can be operational in less than a year. Recovery of target materials is put at more than 90 percent.

quote.text: AMP ONE recovers 90%+ of target materials without touching a human hand.
